description: ReservoirNeuralBench provides OPM Flow-generated reservoir states and control schedules for training and testing neural surrogates. It includes in-distribution and out-of-distribution scenarios on the Norne field geometry. The provider is Daniil Sirota. Coverage: The stated geometry has 46 by 112 by 22 cells and 44,431 active cells. Forecast scenarios use 60 steps of 30 days; these are synthetic model trajectories. Access: The public Hugging Face dataset card describes files and reproduction routes. No simulation payload was downloaded. Licence and cost: The dataset card retains OPM’s ODbL and DbCL terms and distinguishes repository-code terms. Limitations: The hosted preview currently reports a schema-conversion failure. Trained checkpoints are not supplied, and the claimed benchmark scores were not reproduced. For simulation it supports controlled comparison of reservoir surrogate models and generalisation under changed well controls. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
